title: Dynaseal: A Backend-Controlled LLM API Key Distribution Scheme with Constrained Invocation Parameters
content: Due to the exceptional performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in diverse downstream tasks,there has been an exponential growth in edge-device requests to cloud-based models.However, the current authentication mechanism using static Bearer Tokens in request headersfails to provide the flexibility and backend control required for edge-device deployments.To address these limitations, we propose Dynaseal,a novel methodology that enables fine-grained backend constraints on model invocations.
